# AxiomID Design System Documentation

**Version:** 2.0  
**Last Updated:** 2026-08-06  
**Generated by:** Design Harness Application

---

## Design Philosophy

AxiomID's design system blends **terminal-cyberpunk aesthetics** with **premium tech product polish** — inspired by Linear, Vercel, Apple, and SpaceX. The system prioritizes:

- **Clarity over decoration** — Every visual element serves a purpose
- **Trust through precision** — Micro-interactions and consistent patterns build confidence
- **Dark-mode native** — Designed for OLED displays, terminal environments
- **Performance-first** — CSS variables, minimal JS, lazy-loaded heavy components

## Color System

### Primary Accent: PAI Neon Green
```css
--pai-green-500:  #39FF14    /* Primary */
--pai-green-600:  #2ee010
--pai-green-700:  #00CC00    /* Secondary */
--pai-green-bright: #6bff4a  /* Hover/highlight */
--pai-green-glow:  rgba(57, 255, 20, 0.6)
```

### Semantic Color Scale
| Token | Value | Usage |
|-------|-------|-------|
| `--pai-green-50` | `rgba(57, 255, 20, 0.05)` | Subtle backgrounds |
| `--pai-green-100` | `rgba(57, 255, 20, 0.10)` | Light fills |
| `--pai-green-200` | `rgba(57, 255, 20, 0.20)` | Borders |
| `--pai-green-300` | `rgba(57, 255, 20, 0.35)` | Stronger accents |
| `--pai-green-400` | `rgba(57, 255, 20, 0.55)` | Interactive states |

### Background Surfaces (Luminance Stack)
```css
--bg-deepest:     #0a0a0f   /* Page background */

--bg-secondary:   #111118   /* Panels/sidebars */
--bg-tertiary:    #16161f   /* Elevated cards */
--bg-elevated:    #1c1c28   /* Hovered cards */

```

### Text Colors (Luminance Stack)

## Typography

### Font Stacks
```css
--font-display:  'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif
--font-body:     'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif
--font-mono:     'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', monospace
--font-terminal: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', monospace
```

### Type Scale (1.25 Ratio)
| Token | Size | Usage |
|-------|------|-------|
| `--text-xs` | 12px | Labels, badges |
| `--text-sm` | 14px | UI text |
| `--text-base` | 16px | Body text |
| `--text-lg` | 18px | Large body |
| `--text-xl` | 20px | Subheadings |
| `--text-2xl` | 24px | Section titles |
| `--text-3xl` | 32px | Hero headlines |
| `--text-4xl` | 40px | Large headlines |
| `--text-5xl` | 48px | Display |
| `--text-6xl` | 64px | Hero display |

### Font Weights
```css
--weight-regular:  400
--weight-medium:   500
--weight-emphasis: 510   /* Linear-style emphasis */
--weight-semibold: 600
--weight-bold:     700
```

### Letter Spacing
```css
--tracking-tighter: -0.05em  /* Display */
--tracking-tight:   -0.025em /* Headlines */
--tracking-normal:  0
--tracking-wide:    0.025em  /* Labels */
--tracking-wider:   0.05em   /* Uppercase labels */
```

## Shadows

### Border Shadows (Vercel-style)
```css
--shadow-border:        0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.07)
--shadow-border-light:  0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.04)
--shadow-border-green:  0 0 0 1px rgba(57,255,20,0.20)
```

### Elevation Shadows
```css
--shadow-sm:  0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)
--shadow-md:  0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.35)
--shadow-lg:  0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)
--shadow-xl:  0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)
```

### Card Shadow Stacks
```css
--shadow-card:
  0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.07),
  0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.2),
  0 8px 16px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)

--shadow-card-hover:
  0 0 0 1px rgba(57,255,20,0.15),
  0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.3),
  0 12px 24px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)
```

### Glow Shadows (Signature)
```css
--shadow-glow-sm:  0 0 8px  rgba(57,255,20,0.15)
--shadow-glow-md:  0 0 16px rgba(57,255,20,0.20)
--shadow-glow-lg:  0 0 32px rgba(57,255,20,0.25)
```

## Component Patterns

### 1. Glass Card (Base Pattern)
```tsx
<div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/[0.07] bg-white/[0.03] backdrop-blur-[20px] p-6">
  {/* Content */}
</div>
```

### 2. Gradient Text (Signature)
```tsx
<span className="text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-400 via-emerald-500 to-purple-500">
  Gradient Text
</span>
```

### 3. Primary CTA Button
```tsx
<a className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-6 py-3 rounded-xl font-mono text-sm tracking-wider bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-500 to-emerald-600 text-black hover:from-emerald-600 hover:to-emerald-700 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(34,197,94,0.3)] transition-all">
  CTA Text
</a>
```

### 4. Secondary Button
```tsx
<a className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-6 py-3 rounded-xl font-mono text-sm border border-white/10 bg-white/5 text-zinc-300 hover:bg-white/10 hover:border-white/20 transition-all">
  Secondary
</a>
```

### 5. Badge / Status Indicator
```tsx
<span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[9px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20">
  ACTIVE
</span>
```

### 6. Section Header
```tsx
<div className="text-center mb-10 sm:mb-12">
  <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-electric-blue tracking-widest uppercase">
    SECTION LABEL
  </span>
  <h2 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold text-white mt-2">
    Section Title
  </h2>
</div>
```

### 7. Feature Card (Stitch Pattern)
```tsx
<div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/5 bg-white/[0.02] p-6 hover:border-emerald-500/30 transition-all duration-300">
  <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/20 flex items-center justify-center text-emerald-400">
    <Icon className="w-6 h-6" />
  </div>
  <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-white mt-4">Title</h3>
  <p className="text-sm text-zinc-400 mt-2">Description</p>
</div>
```

### 8. Progress Stepper
```tsx
<div className="flex items-center gap-2">
  {[1,2,3,4].map(i => (
    <div key={i} className={`h-1 flex-1 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${i <= step ? "bg-emerald-500" : "bg-white/5"}`} />
  ))}
</div>
```

## Motion Guidelines

### Framer Motion Defaults
```tsx
const defaultTransition = {
  ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1],  // --ease-out
  duration: 0.3             // --duration-300
}

const springTransition = {
  ease: [0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1],  // --ease-spring
  duration: 0.5
}
```

### Animation Patterns
- **Fade + Slide Up:** `initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}`
- **Stagger:** `transition={{ delay: index * 0.1 }}`
- **Hover Scale:** `whileHover={{ scale: 1.03 }}`
- **Tap Scale:** `whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }}`

```css
/* Mobile first - matches Tailwind defaults */
sm:   640px   /* Small tablets */
md:   768px   /* Tablets */
lg:   1024px  /* Laptops */
xl:   1280px  /* Desktop */
2xl:  1536px  /* Large desktop */
```

### Container Max-Widths
- Content: `max-w-6xl` (1152px)

## Accessibility Standards

### Focus States (Required on all interactive elements)
```tsx
className="focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-emerald-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-black"
```

### Semantic HTML
- Use `<main>`, `<section>`, `<header>`, `<footer>`
- `<button>` for actions, `<a>` for navigation
- `aria-label` for icon-only buttons
- `role="status"` for live regions

### Color Contrast
- All text meets WCAG AA (4.5:1) on dark backgrounds
- `--text-primary` (#f0f0f5) on `--bg-primary` (#0d0d14) = 15.8:1
- `--text-secondary` (#b8b8cc) on `--bg-primary` = 9.2:1

---

## Performance Guidelines

### Lazy Loading
```tsx
const HeavyComponent = dynamic(
  () => import('@/components/HeavyComponent'),
  { loading: () => <Skeleton />, ssr: false }
)
```

### CSS Variables Over Inline Styles
- Prefer `style={{ background: 'var(--pai-green)' }}` over hardcoded values
- Use Tailwind arbitrary values for one-offs: `bg-[var(--pai-green)]`

### Bundle Optimization
- Tree-shake Lucide icons: `import { Icon } from 'lucide-react'`
- Dynamic import heavy libraries (framer-motion, charts)

---

## Dark Mode Only
This design system is **dark-mode native**. No light mode variants exist. All tokens assume dark backgrounds.

---

## Implementation Checklist

When adding new components:
- [ ] Use CSS variables for all colors, spacing, shadows
- [ ] Apply glass morphism pattern for cards
- [ ] Include focus-visible styles
- [ ] Use JetBrains Mono for data/mono text
- [ ] Use Inter for body/display text
- [ ] Add hover/tap transitions with `--ease-out`
- [ ] Test at 320px, 768px, 1440px
- [ ] Verify WCAG AA contrast
- [ ] Add to this documentation
